desktop_preview: Preview: the filter engine is not connected on this computer yet. The button only shows how the app will work.
state_on_detail_no_delay: Instruments are removed from all apps.
engine_error_no_pactl: Sound tools not found (pactl). Waaiya needs PulseAudio, or PipeWire with pipewire-pulse.
engine_error_no_sound_server: The sound server is not running (PulseAudio or PipeWire).
engine_error_no_systemd: This system has no systemd user session, which runs the filter in the background.
engine_error_install_failed:
Could not install the filter. Details:
{details}
engine_error_start_failed:
The filter did not start. Details:
{details}
engine_error_service_failed:
The filter stopped with an error. Details:
{details}
autostart_body: Filter the sound as soon as you log in.
blur_body_desktop: Covers people and images on screen, over every window, while Waaiya is open (it works whether the sound filter is on or off). It runs on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere. Closing the Waaiya window stops the blur.
blur_fail_body_desktop: On: the whole screen is covered when the computer is too slow or the blur fails; clicks still reach the windows underneath. Off: the screen stays visible with a red bar at the top.
blur_status_on_visible_desktop: Blur on. This desktop shows the blur in its own screen capture, so a blurred area stays blurred until the scene changes.
blur_status_no_capture:
The blur cannot see the screen. Details:
{details}
blur_status_no_overlay_desktop:
The blur cannot draw over other windows on this desktop. Details:
{details}
blur_status_share_dialog: Choose your screen in the screen-sharing window and allow it. Waaiya asks only once; the picture stays on this computer.
blur_status_exited:
The blur stopped unexpectedly. Turn a blur option off and on to try again. Details:
{details}
engine_detector_failed: The women's singing detector did not load, so voices are muted while that option is on.
blur_status_uncovered: A monitor is not covered by the blur: it was not shared with it, or it was plugged in later. Turn a blur option off and on, and choose every screen in the screen-sharing window.
blur_status_models_missing_desktop: The blur's models are missing from this installation, so it cannot cover anything; a red bar stays at the top of the screen. Reinstall Waaiya.
diag_note_desktop: What Waaiya sees on this computer. Copy it and give it to whoever helps you. The app itself sends nothing.
setting_hold_silence_body_desktop: Recommended. If filtering stops by itself (an error, not you), other apps stay silent until you start again or press Stop, instead of playing music unfiltered.
setting_stereo_body_desktop: Off: mono, which uses less of the computer. On: keeps the left and right sides apart. If the computer is too slow for stereo, it switches to mono by itself.
link_entry_body_desktop: Paste a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram link to watch it with the filter on, or to save it without music.
link_entry_body_watch: Paste a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram link to watch it in your browser with the filter on.
link_watch_note_desktop: Opens in your browser. Waaiya starts the filter first, so the music is removed there too.
link_filter_failed: The filter did not start, so the link was not opened. Start it on the Filter page and try again.
link_singing_note: Women's singing is muted too, as in your settings.
singing_keep_body: Instruments are removed but singing voices are kept, so a lecture with a nasheed under it keeps the nasheed's voice too; whether that is acceptable is your choice.
singing_keep_no_model: This version has no singing model, so the sound stays silent while this is on. Turn it off.
fix_filter_apps_body: These apps play their original sound: Waaiya neither filters nor silences them.
fix_pick_playing_desktop: Apps playing sound now, and the ones already chosen.
fix_blur_apps_body: No covers while one of these apps is alone on the screen. The covers come back as soon as you leave it, or whenever Waaiya is not sure which app is shown.
fix_blur_apps_needs_setup: Needs the one-time setup: without it Waaiya cannot tell which app is on screen, so the blur stays on everywhere.
fix_blur_apps_helper_mode: Waaiya's helper is not running, so the app on screen cannot be read. The blur stays on everywhere until the helper is started again from the Setup page.
fix_hand_body: While the blur runs, drag over any part of the screen to cover it. It stays covered until you remove it or the blur stops.
fix_hand_not_running: Available while the blur runs: filtering on and a blur option on.
fix_note_body: Mark it when it happens. A note keeps the time, the app and the settings. It stays on this device and is never sent.
fix_notes_delete_ask: Delete all the notes? This cannot be undone.
worship_body: Optional. Worked out on this phone from the place you choose. Nothing is sent.
worship_place_no_match: No city found. You can enter coordinates instead.
worship_custom_invalid: Check the numbers and the time zone.
worship_place_invalid: This place cannot be used. Choose it again.
worship_method_note: Chosen from the city's country. Pick the one your mosque follows.
worship_method_tehran: Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran
worship_no_times: No prayer times here today: the sun does not rise or does not set.
worship_silent_body: From each prayer time, Do Not Disturb for the minutes below, then back to how you had it.
worship_mute_body: At each prayer time, media sound (videos, music, games) is muted for the minutes below. The notification can unmute it at once.
worship_dnd_needed: Allow Waaiya to change Do Not Disturb, or the phone cannot go silent.
worship_exact_needed: Alarms and reminders are not allowed for Waaiya, so each change may come up to 10 minutes late, or later while the phone sleeps.
worship_notifications_needed: Notifications are off: you will not see when the phone goes silent or comes back.
worship_tones_body: Waaiya cannot filter the ringtone or notification sounds, only replace them. Choose a plain tone with no music:
worship_tone_permission: Allow Waaiya to modify system settings, come back, and tap again.
worship_tone_failed: This phone did not let Waaiya change it. In Sound settings, choose a tone named “Waaiya plain”.
worship_sms_title: Reply to calls by SMS during prayer
worship_sms_body: In the silent minutes after each prayer time, a call left ringing gets one SMS. Once per number per prayer; never to hidden numbers or short codes.
worship_sms_delay_title: Seconds of ringing before the SMS
worship_sms_cost: Each reply is a normal SMS from your SIM, at your plan's price. Nothing is sent while roaming.
worship_sms_roaming: Roaming now: no SMS is sent.
worship_sms_log_title: Replies sent (kept on this phone only)
worship_why_dnd: To make the phone silent at prayer times, allow Waaiya's Do Not Disturb access on the next page.
worship_why_exact: To act exactly on time, allow Waaiya to set alarms and reminders on the next page. Without it, changes can come up to 10 minutes late.
worship_why_notifications: Allow notifications so that you see each change and can undo it.
worship_why_write: To change your ringtone or notification sound, allow Waaiya to modify system settings on the next page.
worship_why_phone: To know that a call is ringing and its number, Waaiya needs the Phone and Call logs permissions. Nothing leaves the phone except your reply.
worship_why_sms: To send your reply, Waaiya needs permission to send SMS. It sends only that reply, at most once per number per prayer.
worship_missing_dnd: Do Not Disturb access was not allowed, so the silence stays off.
worship_missing_phone: The Phone and Call logs permissions were not allowed, so the SMS reply stays off.
worship_missing_sms: Permission to send SMS was not allowed, so the SMS reply stays off.
protect_body: Decide now, while you are calm: a change that lowers protection waits before it takes effect. A parent can also set a PIN.
protect_delay_body: Stopping the filter, turning off a cover or anything else that lowers protection waits this long. Then you confirm it within 15 minutes, or nothing changes. Turning things on always works at once.
protect_pin_body: With a PIN, every change that lowers protection asks for it first. Changing the waiting period or the PIN asks for it too.
protect_pin_forgot: If the PIN is forgotten, there is no reset: only clearing Waaiya's data or reinstalling it, which also clears all its settings.
protect_pin_differ: The two new PINs are not the same.
protect_pin_wrong: Wrong PIN. {count} tries left before a pause.
protect_locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again at {time}.
protect_ready: {what}: the wait is over. Still want it? Confirm before {time}, or nothing changes.
protect_wait_body: {what} takes effect at {time}, if you still want it then. You confirm it here within 15 minutes after that.
protect_already_waiting: Already waiting: it takes effect at {time}.
protect_started: It takes effect at {time}. Confirm it then.
protect_held_back: This change is held back by the protection settings.
protect_limits: What this cannot stop: force stop, uninstalling, clearing Waaiya's data and Android's own settings. Blocking those needs device-admin or accessibility powers that Waaiya does not use. This protects against a weak moment, not against a determined person.
protect_limits_desktop: What this cannot stop: the waaiya command in a terminal, removing Waaiya or deleting its settings folder. This protects against a weak moment, not against a determined person.
